version.blurb: Word-for-word calque of the Leningrad text · English

verses.t: word-of YHWH who has-been, toward Joel son-of Pethuel.
hear this-f the-old, and-make-listen, all-of dwelling-of the-land ; is-it-the-she-has-been this-f in-days-of-you-pl, and-if in-days-of fathers-of-you-pl.
on-her to/for-sons-of-you-pl recount ; and-sons-of-you-pl to/for-sons-of-them, and-sons-of-them to/for-generation another.
remainder-of the-locust has-eaten the-locust, and-remainder-of the-locust has-eaten the-locust ; the-locust has-eaten and-remainder-of the-locust,.
make-awake drunken and-weep, and-make-wail all-of drinking-of wine ; on sweet, for has-been-cut from-lip-of-you-pl.
for nation has-ascended on land-of-me, mighty and-naught number ; tooths-of-him tooths-of lion, and-jaws-of lion to/for-him.
vine-of-me has-put to/for-horror, and-fig-of-me to/for-splinter ; strip he-has-striped-her and-he-has-made-throw, tendrils-of-her have-made-whiten.
wail, like-virgin girded-of sack on master-of youths-of-her.
has-been-made-cut offering and-drink from-house-of YHWH ; the-priests ministering-of have-mourned, YHWH.
field has-been-ruined, has-mourned ground ; for grain has-been-ruined, has-made-wither new has-weakened oil.
make-blush farmers make-wail tends, on wheat and-on barley ; for harvest-of field has-perished.
the-vine has-made-wither, and-the-fig has-weakened ; pomegranate also palm and-apple all-of trees-of the-field have-withered, for rejoicing has-made-wither from sons-of man.
gird and-mourn the-priests make-wail ministering-of altar, come lodge in-the-sacks, ministering-of god-of-me ; for has-been-withholded from-house-of god-of-you-pl offering and-drink.
consecrate fast call assembly, gather old all-of dwelling-of the-land, house-of YHWH god-of-you-pl ; and-out toward YHWH.
alas to/for-the-day ; for near day-of YHWH, and-like-violence from-Almighty will-come.
is-it-not before eyes-of-us food has-been-cut ; from-house-of god-of-us joy and-rejoicing.
grains have-shriveled under clods-of-them, have-been-desolate treasures, have-been-overthrowed granaries ; for grain has-made-wither.
what animal has-been-sighed have-been-perplexed flocks-of cattle, for naught pasture to/for-them ; also flocks-of the-flock have-been-guiltied.
toward-you YHWH I-will-call ; for fire has-eaten habitations-of wilderness, and-flame, has-kindled all-of trees-of the-field.
also animals-of field she-will-for toward-you ; for channels-of waters have-withered, and-fire, has-eaten habitations-of the-wilderness.
blow trumpet in-Zion and-make-shout in-mountain-of holiness-of-me, let-them-tremble, all-of dwelling-of the-land ; for coming day-of YHWH for near.

day-of darkness and-darkness day-of cloud and-cloud, like-dawn spreaded on the-mountains ; people many and-mighty, like-him not has-been-been from the-age, and-after-him not will-make-add, until year-of generation and-generation.

to/for-faces-of-him fire has-eaten, and-after-him will-kindle flame ; like-garden-of Eden the-land to/for-faces-of-him and-after-him wilderness-of desolation, and-also survivor not has-been to/for-him.
like-sight-of horses sight-of-him ; and-like-horses thus they-will-run.
like-voice-of chariots on heads-of the-mountains will-about, like-voice-of flame-of fire, eating stubble ; like-people mighty, arranged-of battle.
from-faces-of-him peoples will-twist ; all-of faces they-have-gathered pale.
like-mighty they-will-run, like-mans-of battle they-will-ascend wall ; and-man in-ways-of-him will-walk, and-not ways-of-them will-lend.
and-man brother-of-him not they-will-crowd, great in-highway-of-him they-will-walk ; and-about the-missile they-will-fall not they-will-off.
in-the-city they-will-rush in-the-wall they-will-run, in-the-houses they-will-ascend ; about the-windows will-come like-the-thief.
to/for-faces-of-him land has-trembled, have-shaked heavens ; sun and-moon and-stars have-darked, have-gathered brightness-of-them.
and-YHWH has-given voice-of-him to/for-faces-of rampart-of-him, for many very camp-of-him, for mighty doing-of word-of-him ; for great day-of YHWH and-feared very and-who will-make-sustain-him.
and-also now utterance-of YHWH, return until-me in-all-of heart-of-you-pl ; and-in-fast and-in-weeping and-in-mourning.
and-tear heart-of-you-pl and-do-not garments-of-you-pl, and-return toward YHWH god-of-you-pl ; for gracious and-compassionate he, slow-of noses and-many-of kindness, and-sorried on the-evil.
who knowing he-will-return and-he-has-been-sorried ; and-has-made-remain after-him blessing, offering and-drink, to/for-YHWH god-of-you-pl.
blow trumpet in-Zion ; consecrate fast call assembly.
gather people consecrate assembly gather old, gather infants, and-suckling-of breasts ; son-in-law let-exit from-chamber-of-him, and-daughter-in-law from-canopy-of-her.

between the-hall and-to/for-the-altar, the-priests ministering-of let-weep, YHWH ; and-will-say pity-heh YHWH on people-of-you and-do-not let-give inheritance-of-you to/for-reproach to/for-rule in-them nations, to/for-what will-say in-the-peoples, where god-of-them.
YHWH and-has-jealoused to/for-land-of-him ; people-of-him and-has-spared on.

YHWH and-has-answered and-has-said to/for-people-of-him lo-me sending to/for-you-pl the-grain and-the-new and-the-oil, and-you-pl-have-satisfied him ; and-not I-will-give you-pl still reproach in-the-nations.

and-the-northern I-will-make-remove on-you-pl and-I-have-made-banish-him toward land dryness and-desolation with faces-of-him toward the-sea the-eastern, and-end-of-him toward the-sea the-last ; stench-of-him and-has-ascended and-will-ascend stench-of-him, for has-made-magnify to/for-do.
do-not let-fear ground ; rejoice and-rejoice, for YHWH has-made-magnify to/for-do.
do-not let-fear animals-of sirion, for have-sprouted habitations-of wilderness ; for tree has-lifted fruit-of-him, fig and-vine they-have-given helech-of-them.
and-sons-of Zion rejoice and-rejoice in-YHWH god-of-you-pl, for has-given to/for-you-pl the-rain to/for-rightness ; rain rain and-spring in-the-first and-has-made-go to/for-you-pl.
the-threshings and-have-filled grain ; the-wines and-have-made-overflow new and-oil.
and-I-have-completed to/for-you-pl the-years, who the-locust the-locust and-the-locust and-the-locust has-eaten ; helech-of-me the-great, who I-have-sended in-you-pl.
and-you-pl-have-eaten eat and-satisfy, and-you-pl-have-boasted name-of YHWH god-of-you-pl, who has-done with-you-pl to/for-make-wonder ; and-not they-will-blush people-of-me to/for-age.
and-you-pl-have-known for in-entrails-of Israel I, and-I YHWH god-of-you-pl and-naught still ; and-not they-will-blush people-of-me to/for-age.

and-has-been after thus I-will-pour spirit-of-me on all-of flesh, and-have-been-prophesied sons-of-you-pl and-daughters-of-you-pl ; old-of-you-pl dreams will-dream, youths-of-you-pl, visions will-see.
and-also on the-servants and-on the-maidservants ; in-the-days the-they, I-will-pour spirit-of-me.
and-I-have-given wonders, in-the-heavens and-in-the-land ; blood and-fire, and-columns-of smoke.
the-sun will-be-overturned to/for-darkness, and-the-moon to/for-blood ; to/for-faces-of come day-of YHWH, the-great and-the-feared.
all and-has-been who will-call in-name-of YHWH will-be-escaped ; for in-mountain-of Zion and-in-Jerusalem survivor will-be like-when has-said YHWH, and-in-the-survivors, who YHWH calling.
for behold in-the-days the-they and-in-the-time the-he ; who I-will-return I-will-make-return captivity-of Judah and-Jerusalem.

and-I-have-gathered all-of the-nations, and-I-have-made-go-them, toward valley-of Jehoshaphat ; and-I-have-been-judged with-them there on people-of-me and-inheritance-of-me Israel who they-have-scattered in-the-nations, and-land-of-me they-have-divided.
and-toward people-of-me they-have-loted allotted ; and-they-have-given the-youth in-the-fornicate, and-the-maiden they-have-sold in-the-wine and-they-have-drunk.

and-also what you to/for-me Tyre and-Sidon, and-all-of borders-of Philistia ; is-it-the-recompense you completing on-me, and-if weaning you on-me, swift haste, I-will-make-return recompense-of-you-pl in-head-of-you-pl.
who silver-of-me and-gold-of-me you-pl-have-taken ; and-desires-of-me the-good, you-pl-have-made-come to/for-temples-of-you-pl.
and-sons-of Judah and-sons-of Jerusalem, you-pl-have-sold to/for-sons-of the-Greek ; sake make-remove-of-them on border-of-them.
lo-me making-rouse-of-them, from the-place, who you-pl-have-sold them there-ward ; and-I-have-made-return recompense-of-you-pl in-head-of-you-pl.
and-I-have-sold sons-of-you-pl and-daughters-of-you-pl in-hand-of sons-of Judah, and-they-have-sold-them to/for-Sabean toward nation far ; for YHWH has-spoken.
call this-f in-the-nations, consecrate battle ; make-rouse the-mighty, let-them-approach let-them-ascend, all-of mans-of the-battle.
crush plowshares-of-you-pl to/for-swords, and-pruners-of-you-pl to/for-spears ; the-weak, let-him-say mighty I.
help and-come all-of the-nations from-around and-they-have-been-gathered ; there-ward, make-descend YHWH mighty-of-you.
let-be-roused the-nations and-let-ascend, toward valley-of Jehoshaphat ; for there I-will-dwell to/for-judge all-of the-nations from-around.
send sickle, for has-boiled harvest ; come go for wine has-filled, have-made-overflow the-wines, for many evil-of-them.
crowds crowds, in-valley-of the-Decision ; for near day-of YHWH, in-valley-of the-Decision.
sun and-moon they-have-darked ; and-stars have-gathered brightness-of-them.
and-YHWH from-Zion will-roar and-from-Jerusalem voice-of-him will-give, and-have-shaked heavens and-land ; and-YHWH refuge to/for-people-of-him, and-security to/for-sons-of Israel.
and-you-pl-have-known for I YHWH god-of-you-pl, dwelling in-Zion mountain-of holiness-of-me ; Jerusalem and-has-been holiness, and-stranger not they-will-pass in-her still.

the-he and-has-been in-the-day will-drip the-mountains sweet and-the-Gibat will-walk milk, and-all-of channels-of Judah will-walk waters ; and-spring from-house-of YHWH will-exit, and-has-made-water torrent-of the-Shittim.
Egypt to/for-desolation and-Edom will-be, to/for-wilderness-of desolation she-will-be ; from-violence-of sons-of Judah, who they-have-poured blood innocent in-land-of-them.
and-Judah to/for-age she-will-dwell ; and-Jerusalem to/for-generation and-generation.
and-I-have-cleared blood-of-them not I-have-cleared ; and-YHWH dwelling in-Zion.
